description: This Java class defines a LogNode filter called MessageOnlyLogFilter that implements the LogNode interface. Its purpose is to filter log messages by removing all metadata such as tags and priorities, passing only the message content to the next LogNode in the chain. It provides constructors for chaining LogNodes and methods to get and set the next node.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter for logging that suppresses metadata, only forwarding log messages.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with a next LogNode for chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Filters the log by passing only the message to the next LogNode, ignoring other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain where log messages will be forwarded.
